sources.label: Valve 7.41 · facet removal and Meepo leveling
Valve scripts · attribute limits and recipe flags

abilities.name: Blade Fury
abilities.summary: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with [see in-game value]%% magic resistance and dealing damage every [see in-game value]s to nearby enemy units.

abilities.name: Healing Ward
abilities.summary: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.

abilities.name: Blade Dance
abilities.summary: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack..

abilities.name: Swiftslash
abilities.summary: Performs a short Omnislash for [see in-game value] seconds..

abilities.name: Bladeform
abilities.summary: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every [see in-game value]s that Juggernaut does not take damage.

abilities.name: Omnislash
abilities.summary: Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate.

abilities.name: Dragon Slave
abilities.summary: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path..

abilities.name: Light Strike Array
abilities.summary: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies..

abilities.name: Fiery Soul
abilities.summary: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell.

abilities.name: Flame Cloak
abilities.summary: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance.

abilities.name: Slow Burn
abilities.summary: Lina's abilities deal an additional [see in-game value]%% damage as burn damage over [see in-game value]s..

abilities.name: Laguna Blade
abilities.summary: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage..

abilities.name: Berserker's Call
abilities.summary: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration..

abilities.name: Battle Hunger
abilities.summary: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends.

abilities.name: Counter Helix
abilities.summary: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies..

abilities.name: Culling Blade
abilities.summary: Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage.

abilities.name: One Man Army
abilities.summary: Axe gains Strength based on [see in-game value]%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within [see in-game value] distance from Axe.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.summary: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground.

abilities.name: Fade Bolt
abilities.summary: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage.

abilities.name: Arcane Supremacy
abilities.summary: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification..

abilities.name: Spell Steal
abilities.summary: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast.

abilities.name: Curiosity
abilities.summary: Rubick gains [see in-game value] stack of Curiosity per level that grants him [see in-game value] base damage, [see in-game value]%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and [see in-game value] AOE Bonus.

abilities.name: Crystal Nova
abilities.summary: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area..

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.summary: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: Arcane Aura
abilities.summary: Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map.

abilities.name: Crystal Clone
abilities.summary: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles.

abilities.name: Glacial Guard
abilities.summary: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier..

abilities.name: Freezing Field
abilities.summary: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with [see in-game value] random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage.

abilities.name: Earthbind
abilities.summary: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it..

abilities.name: Poof
abilities.summary: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for [see in-game value] seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

abilities.name: Ransack
abilities.summary: Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

abilities.name: Dig
abilities.summary: Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for [see in-game value]s.

abilities.name: MegaMeepo
abilities.summary: Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a [see in-game value] radius around him on top of his shoulders.

abilities.name: Divided We Stand
abilities.summary: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo.

abilities.name: Geomancy
abilities.summary: Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain.

abilities.name: MegaMeepo Fling
abilities.summary: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a [see in-game value] range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed..

abilities.name: Cloak and Dagger
abilities.summary: Cloak and Dagger invisibility requires detection; detection does not disable Tricks of the Trade.

abilities.name: Blink Strike
abilities.summary: Blink Strike reaches vulnerable backline heroes.

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.summary: Smoke Screen silences while inside its area; a basic dispel alone does not remove the ground effect.

abilities.name: Immaterial
abilities.summary: Evasion can reduce an attacking core’s damage reliability.

abilities.name: Phantom Strike
abilities.summary: Phantom Strike reaches vulnerable targets.

abilities.name: Coup de Grace
abilities.summary: Critical attacks threaten exposed supports.

abilities.name: Juxtapose
abilities.summary: Multiple illusions demand compatible area damage rather than single-target burst alone.

abilities.name: Shadow Wave
abilities.summary: Healing can prolong trades; healing reduction does not cancel Shallow Grave.

abilities.name: Global Silence
abilities.summary: Global Silence can interrupt spell participation and is removable by a suitable basic dispel.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.summary: Ball Lightning reaches the backline; repositioning is not a hard counter to repeated jumps.

abilities.name: Sadist
abilities.summary: Recovery can sustain repeated lane trades.

abilities.name: Marksmanship
abilities.summary: Ranged physical attacks punish unprotected supports.

abilities.name: Take Aim
abilities.summary: Long-range attacks threaten exposed targets.

threats.explanation: Ranged wave and spell damage can force repeated health recovery.
An area stun can set up follow-up damage.
A targeted burst spell threatens exposed supports.
Area spell harassment slows retreat.
A root can enable follow-up attacks; it does not prohibit every movement or item action.
Berserker’s Call pierces debuff immunity; BKB does not stop the taunt.
An isolated target can suffer repeated physical attacks.
Lift controls an exposed target; stolen spell threats are not inferred.
Repeated roots can restrict movement.
Coordinated clones can deliver spell burst.
Cloak and Dagger invisibility requires detection; detection does not disable Tricks of the Trade.
Blink Strike reaches vulnerable backline heroes.
Smoke Screen silences while inside its area; a basic dispel alone does not remove the ground effect.
Evasion can reduce an attacking core’s damage reliability.
Phantom Strike reaches vulnerable targets.
Critical attacks threaten exposed supports.
Multiple illusions demand compatible area damage rather than single-target burst alone.
